prompt: A job queue must deliver work first-in-first-out. A producer enqueues job-1 and then job-2, and a consumer then drains the queue. Arrange the redis-cli commands in execution order so jobs are consumed FIFO.
explanation: Each LPUSH prepends at the head, so after both pushes the list reads job-2, job-1 with job-1 at the tail. RPOP takes from the tail, which still holds the oldest entry, so the consumer receives job-1 first. Pushing and popping opposite ends is the classic FIFO pairing; pushing and popping the same end would turn the list into a stack.
